title: Reciprocity and Unveiling in Two-Sided Reputation Systems: Evidence from an Experiment on Airbnb
authors: Andrey Fradkin; Elena Grewal; David Holtz
eligible_reason: Randomized experiment on Airbnb (simultaneous review reveal vs. immediate reveal); main results are difference-in-means regressions felm(y ~ is_treatment) on trip-level data, plus principal stratification and host-outcome regressions with market FE. No staggered adoption, no unit-by-time panel.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm, lm, glm). Cross-sectional treatment-control comparisons from a single experiment.

specs.exclusion_reason: randomized experiment, cross-sectional treatment indicator; no adoption timing
cross-sectional regression on experimental assignment with market FE

data_files_note: README: raw data proprietary to Airbnb; shipped files are randomly generated so code runs, results differ from the paper.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). RCT, not DiD; synthetic data.
